findings.claim: The generated text alternative, and the PDF rendered from it, do not preserve a clear reading sequence: adjacent list/table cells are concatenated without separators (for example, "computerhttp" and "URLport"), and the recap, cheat sheet, and sources are repeated up to three times. The same concatenation and repetition pattern appears in the other four artifact.md companions. Learners who use the static alternative receive a materially less readable, unnecessarily long version of otherwise clear HTML content.

evidence.section: Understanding SC 1.3.2: Meaningful Sequence — intent and benefits

findings.recommendation: Correct the deterministic HTML-to-Markdown derivation so list and table cells retain spaces, line breaks, or Markdown structure and so recap, cheat sheet, and sources are emitted once. Regenerate all five artifact.md files and the localhost-and-ports PDF from the corrected Markdown, then review the extracted PDF text for the same sequence and duplication defects.

findings.claim: All five topic manifests declare the topic lab absent while their reason says the course-level lab decision is still pending plan step R5. That is not a final applicability decision and conflicts with each manifest’s root lab value of "none" and the module’s empty moduleLabs list. The omission itself is pedagogically defensible for this F1 Concept day because the pages provide substantial simulated practice and the frozen calendar marks F1 requiredLab false; the recorded reason is the defect.
findings.recommendation: Replace the pending-plan boilerplate in all five artifact lab reasons with the final reviewed rationale (embedded practice covers these topic objectives and F1 has no required lab), or point to a real course-level lab if one is approved later. Do not add a lab or alter the syllabus merely to resolve the wording.
